schedule.about: Package PREF (2026-10-25): a level here is a Forge level gained over the copy's own starting level (Level 0 = unlevelled). From fromMap on, each map gives perMap different copies +1 level, picked by a generator seeded with seed + the map number among the copies still below their cap (a Base card stops at Lv 4, the others at their top level), so Map N always gives the same deck. tools/opt/ref_decks.js bakes this file into arena_app.js (REF_DECK_SETS).
